premises.text: Urban traffic, air pollution, and low-quality, outdated, under-teched Asian scooters create demand for a better commute vehicle
premises.evidence_span: we've been suffering from traffic problems and air pollution

premises.text: Fully electric e-bike with removable aluminum batteries (up to ~200 km), LED visibility, dual disc brakes, smooth motor, and aluminum-titanium frame
premises.evidence_span: Mineral 2.0 is fully electronic, with clean energy, e-bike

premises.text: Customization system for steering, color, and components via adaptive manufacturing, priced from about $1,700 for daily commute and scooter replacement
premises.evidence_span: We have a customization system where you can choose the option of the steering wheel

value.text: Cleaner, safer, more modern daily commuting that replaces old-fashioned scooters
value.evidence_span: people who use the bike for daily commute, and who wants to replace their old fashioned scooters

causal_links.evidence_span: including the scooter market in Asia, they are low quality and out of fashion

notes: Battery/LED/brakes/motor/frame features folded as feature cascade of one electric e-bike mechanism (v1.5.1 §4.1.7). Gas-powered 1.0 treated as prior framing, not a premise. Customization plus price and commute segment kept as one commercial/GTM premise. Anti-template: problem, product, and commerce are separately revisable.
